rationale: uswin-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=200, epochs=8, batch_size=2, lr=0.0002, uswin_c=24, swin_window=8, swin_heads=4, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=ITER-1 (breast-ct-claude-agentic-uswin-search-20260703-01) ONBOARDING. Onboard U-Swin on the RE-SPLIT breast_ct (train 3600 / val 200 / test 200, seed 20260703; verified disjoint, all 512x512) scoring val=200 under the HARD 20-min compute budget. SIX-BOX: (1) READ prior numbers: the last breast U-Swin campaign was breast-ct-calibrated-tpe-uswin-search-20260521-01 at the OLD 256px demo geometry; its best was iter-18 hr=0.7174 / val_ssim=0.9970 / params=3.954M with epochs=14, lr=1.8046e-4, batch_size=2, uswin_c=24, swin_window=16, swin_heads=8. NOTE: that geometry was 256px; the re-split breast is now 512x512 (4x pixels), so per-epoch cost and GPU memory are ~4x -> window=16+heads=8+bs=2 risks OOM AND overshooting the 20-min wall. (2) FAILURE MODE (anticipated): OOM / wall-overrun at 512px if I copy the 256px champion verbatim. (3) ONE KNOB is moot on an onboarding iter (no prior 512px iter to change from); I deliberately pick a MEMORY-SAFE, WALL-SAFE baseline near the prior champion: uswin_c=24 (same), swin_window=8 (down from 16 to halve attention-window memory and satisfy the OOM caveat), swin_heads=4 (down from 8), lr=2e-4 (near prior-best 1.8e-4), batch_size=2 (same), grad_clip=1.0. epochs=8 CONSERVATIVE with a max_train_s=1000 backstop so train+score cannot exceed the 1200s (20-min) wall even if a 512px epoch is unexpectedly expensive; iter-1 MEASURES the per-epoch cost so iters 2-5 can size epochs precisely. Set PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True (in dispatch env) to guard OOM. (4) HYPOTHESIS: a moderate 24-channel/window-8/head-4 U-Swin trained 8 epochs on 200 breast cases at 512px clears the breast FBP baseline (hr>0) and lands a clean end-to-end iter inside 20 min, establishing the per-epoch timing and a hr baseline near/below the prior 256px 0.717. FALSIFIER: OOM, wall-overrun (train+score>1200s), or hr<=0 -> next iter shrinks capacity or epochs. (5) HARD 20-min budget honored via epochs=8 + max_train_s=1000 backstop; val_n=200 = whole val pool (cap honored, was 400). (6) I dispatch iter-2 myself when iter-1 lands (no control return).
